notes.title: Damned 2 Update – The Blood Oracle
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Everyone![/h2][p][/p][p]We are happy to announce that our first content update for Damned 2 is now live!  [/p][p][/p][p]This update brings one of the biggest new mechanics so far: the [b]Blood Oracle[/b]. Survivors can now sacrifice the [b]Heart[/b] at the [b]Blood Altar[/b] to summon the [b]Blood Whisper[/b], a spectral guide that points to the next missing item. It’s a way to help when progress stalls, while still keeping the tension high because the [b]monster can[/b] [b]see the Heart and hears your voice chat while you’re carrying it[/b].
[/p][h2]
New Feature: Blood Oracle
[/h2][h3]Blood Altar[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209845/21475bd2f5357384df1aa76786e188354cf08c93.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Assists survivors in finding lost items by summoning the Blood Whisper.[/p][/*][*][p]Survivors must locate the Sacrificial Heart and place it on the altar.[/p][/*][*][p]Monsters cannot see or collide with the altar.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]The Sacrificial Heart[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209845/eb9423d8ba974ffca6141ba041a63f56edda27be.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Spawns in one of the already opened rooms a few minutes into a match.[/p][/*][*][p]The altar can reveal the Heart’s location or show the timer for the next spawn.[/p][/*][*][p]When active, the Heart emits a global directional heartbeat and moves around the map.[/p][/*][*][p]If carried, the monster can [b]see the Heart and hear the carrier’s VOIP[/b], and the AI becomes aware of the holder.[/p][/*][*][p]If not picked up within 3 minutes, the Heart respawns in another room.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]The Blood Whisper[/h3][list][*][p]Slowly guides survivors to the next key or puzzle item.[/p][/*][*][p]Will not appear if survivors already hold an unused key or if there are unsolved puzzles, though the altar will still point to what’s missing.[/p][/*][*][p]Disappears once the guided item is collected; then a new Heart spawns.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Available Difficulty Modes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Beginner[/b] – First Heart at 4 minutes; new Heart spawns 1 minute after the last item is collected.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Normal[/b] – First Heart at 5 minutes; new Heart spawns 3 minutes later.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Limited[/b] – First Heart at 7 minutes; new Hearts spawn 5 minutes later. Limited to 2 total.[/p][/*][*][p][b]No Altar[/b] – Removes all altars from the map.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Banners[/h2][p]4 New banners for you to collect. [/p][list][*][p][b]The Heart[/b]: Use the Blood Oracle 4 times.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209845/67d6b151c3ee484dca268c58cff4638830de5838.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Blood Altar[/b]: Use the Blood Oracle 13 times in a match with the Normal Preset against a monster.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209845/7d2a61eddf8402a7b024d9c6f326b7b25a3a57b9.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Blood God[/b]: With 4 survivors, win using the Impossible Preset against Mary AI on Rose Crimson, and activate the Blood Altar 2 times during the match.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209845/1959fb4243fff4aefb7b1021eae2eae60426d2c8.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Host of the Damned[/b]: Complete 20 games in a public lobby.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209845/c6372b65bb8caad3e7e0d41bc3fa4bb77f2e8ac5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Gameplay[/h2][list][*][p]Survivor lives now persist across the match. Players who reconnect return with the same lives they had before disconnecting.[/p][/*][*][p]Players who rejoin with zero lives cannot select a survivor that is still alive.[/p][/*][*][p]Players joining mid-game cannot take a dead survivor slot if a living one is available.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Maps[/h2][list][*][p]Added Blood Altars to all maps (one guaranteed in the main corridor/room; others may appear randomly).[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted collision to prevent objects from getting stuck.[/p][/*][*][p]Added more puzzles across maps to reduce chances of puzzle shortages.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]UI[/h2][list][*][p]Survivors can now see the remaining lives of other survivors.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved voice chat feedback.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Escape door light now updates correctly for late-joining players.[/p][/*][*][p]Possible fix for Blight not attacking when too close.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed client updates after leaving the profile menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed inconsistent breakable object pieces.[/p][/*][*][p]Possible fix for breakable objects not auto-picking up.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed buzzing sounds from lights that shouldn’t have them.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a potential soft lock at Clandestine Hospital due to an incorrect spawn.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed disappearing mouse when tutorial + chat were open.[/p][/*][*][p]Possible fix for puzzle letters not appearing on the ground.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed valve rotation lock when survivors added valves too quickly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some puzzles floating.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed inventory items not clearing when a player left the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed small issue with Blight’s energy bar UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Possible fix for profile window showing the wrong player.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a potential soft lock with the Oracle’s Gemstone puzzle at the Missing Warehouse.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]What’s Next[/h2][p]We’re already working on the next steps for Damned 2:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Game tutorial[/b] for new Damned players.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Blight rework[/b], making its gameplay more unique.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New puzzles[/b] to expand match variety.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New maps[/b] to explore and survive.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Monster[/b] – a well-known character from Damned 1 will soon return to haunt your dreams.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We’re excited to see how you use this new mechanic, and as always, keep sending us your feedback![/p]

notes.title: Damned 2 Early Access is Live!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Everyone![/h2][p][/p][p]After years of development, feedback, and sleepless nights, we're beyond excited (and a little terrified) to finally say it:[/p][p][/p][h3]🎉[b]Damned 2 is officially out in Early Access![/b]🎉[/h3][h3][/h3][p]We’re the same indie team behind the original [i]Damned[/i] (2014), and we’re proud to bring you a brand-new take on asymmetrical horror.[/p][p]In [i]Damned 2[/i], a group of [b]4 survivors[/b] must escape from a terrifying location while being hunted by [b]1 powerful monster[/b] — controlled by another player or AI. Your only tools are your wits, teamwork, and whatever you can find scattered throughout the map. Explore dark, cursed environments, solve puzzles, unlock doors, and stay one step ahead of the creature stalking you.[/p][p]Each match is different thanks to randomized puzzles, key locations, and item placement — making survival not just about skill, but adaptation and communication. Whether you're creeping down the halls of an abandoned hotel or sprinting through a creepy mortuary, danger is always just around the corner.[/p][p][/p][h3]What’s included in the Early Access launch:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Nine fully playable maps.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Three deadly monsters:[/b] Lurker, Mary, and Blight![/p][/*][*][p][b]Eight unique puzzles[/b], key randomization, and procedural item placement.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Online multiplayer with voice chat.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Original Soundtrack by Matt Collins[/b] (composer of Damned 1).[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]And most importantly… [b]chaos.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We'll be sharing our [b]roadmap soon[/b], and your feedback will help shape what's next.[/p][p][/p][h3]Why your voice matters[/h3][p]We're a tiny indie team — just two people — and this game wouldn’t exist without the support and passion of our community. This Early Access phase is a crucial time for us. Your bug reports, gameplay feedback, balance suggestions, and crazy ideas are incredibly valuable to help us refine the experience.[/p][p]So please, dive in, test the game, break things, and tell us what you find![/p][list][*][p]Chat with us directly on [b]Discord[/b] and in the [b]Community Hub[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Share clips, tag us, and spread the word[/p][/*][*][p]Leave a review if you’re enjoying the experience[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Thank you ❤️[/h3][p]From the bottom of our hearts, thank you to everyone who’s followed this project, tested it, sent us feedback, shared excitement, or just cheered us on. We're building [i]Damned 2[/i] alongside you, and we can't wait to see what you'll do with it.[/p][p]See you… in the dark. 🔦[/p][p]— Daniel & Henrique
[i]9heads Games[/i][/p]

notes.title: Damned 2 Final Playtest Announcement!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Everyone![/h3][p][/p][p]We are excited to finally announce our final playtest before [b]Early Access![/b][/p][p]The playtest will take place from [b]July 3rd to July 7th[/b], and you’ll be able to try out new maps, meet the new survivors, explore new mechanics, and what you've all been waiting for… [u][i][b]The Blight![/b][/i][/u][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209845/eb71cd1bc8b41a3f999e158b269586bf57742415.png"][/img][/p][p]The Blight is now among us! Ready to lunge and leap, survivors must now be extra weary of their surroundings, all while slowly unlocking their escape. Able to manipulate and absorb light from the environment (yes, even your flashlights!), the Blight is a monster that preys on the one thing you treasure most - light. Survivors must now be extra careful, as their reprieve now fuels the Blight in various ways.[/p][p][/p][p]But to face this new, fearsome entity, are two new survivors.
[u][i][b]Meet Mother Lucy and Mac![/b][/i][/u][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209845/136a7da188edffd13c70245afa94b94f00bf59d6.png"][/img][/p][p]A close friend of our beloved Father John (Damned 1), [b]Mother Lucy[/b] joins the survivors to search for clues about her dear friend’s mysterious disappearance. What happened to John at Rose Crimson then, 13 years ago? Will Mother Lucy find the answers to her many questions? Bearer of the Light, Mother Lucy is a clever and courageous woman - afraid of no demon, she is ready to light the path for fellow survivors in their quest for truth.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Mac[/b] - [i]short for MacAllister[/i] - joins his friends Lily and Lucas along accompanying survivors in the nightmare. Other than yearning for munchies, Mac steps out of his comfort zone in his pursuit of answers relating to his father, the illegal scientific experiments he got involved in, and the letters Mac had recently started receiving in his name.[/p][p][/p][p]This playtest also introduces a brand-new map: [/p][p][u][i][b]The Ashen Mortuary.[/b][/i][/u][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209845/745fb6b42aa385293daf233e59f0e3a7df58084c.png"][/img][/p][p]The Ashen Mortuary is a towering building, housing dozens of valuable pottery and vases, rumored to store stashed goods from previous survivors, but beware… the darkness hears everything. Explore the old, decrepit mortuary slow and steady, and watch your step, as you wouldn't want to fall with [i]no railing![/i][/p][p][/p][p]And before we end this announcement, we want to thank our amazing community for helping us turn [b]Damned 2[/b] into a worthy successor to the pioneer of the asymmetrical horror genre - as a token of appreciation, everyone who joins the playtest will receive a exclusive player Banner. [/p][p][/p][p]join this upcoming Damned 2 playtest and receive access to the exclusive [b]Crash Test Banner[/b] (made available on launch), symbolizing your bravery in testing and reporting the most terrifying bugs that haunt developers and players alike in multiplayer games. Seriously, bug-fixing has us feeling Damned in real life sometimes.[/p][p][/p][p] Introducing: the [u][i][b]Crash Test Banner![/b][/i][/u][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209845/2f02f38bc41cc01a2a598dd3950924be7bef131d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][u][i][b]See you in the final playtest! [/b][/i][/u][/p]

notes.title: Damned 2 Update - 0.6.0000
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

A new update for Damned 2 is now live. This patch introduces the UV Light mode, which allows survivors to reveal hidden messages and destroy traps. A new puzzle, Oracle’s Gemstone, has been added along with two new maps, Clandestine Hospital and The Great Vault. Various gameplay improvements, balance changes, and bug fixes have also been implemented.  

We are continuing to expand the UV Light mechanics and will be adding more interactions in future updates. Our focus will now shift to implementing the two remaining survivors and the new monster.  

Thank you to everyone who participated in testing and reported bugs. Your feedback has been invaluable in improving the game. If this patch proves to be stable, we plan to hold a [b]Steam Playtest this weekend.[/b]

Just a reminder: this update is currently available only to select Discord members with access to our internal build.  

[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]New Flashlight Mode:[/b] UV Light – Reveals hidden messages and destroys monsters' traps.  
[*] [b]New Puzzle:[/b] Oracle's Gemstone 
[*] [b]New Maps:[/b] Clandestine Hospital & The Great Vault  
[/list]
[b]UV Light Changes [/b]
[list]
[*] Fool’s Trap can now be destroyed with UV Light.  
[*] Cursed Dolls can now be destroyed with UV Light.  
[*]Added Flashlight option in [i]Control Settings[/i] to customize toggling with the new UV mode.  
[/list]
[b]Gameplay Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Puzzle papers and Laser Connection power switch now highlight when a survivor is near and looking at them.  
[*] Lurker energy loss (Simple form): Increased from [b]0 → 6[/b].  
[*]Max puzzles per match: Increased from [b]5 → 7[/b].  
[*]Mary (Berserking): Added blood-red eye screen effect.  
[*]Battery & Sanity Pill spawns now adjust based on the number of survivors at the start of the game.  
[*]Turn Table music attenuation distance reduced to avoid disturbing the Radio Frequency puzzle.  
[*] Lurker (Invisible speed):Increased from [b]330 → 440[/b].  
[*] Mary (Berserker speed): Decreased from [b]800 → 700[/b].  
[*] Mary AI ground friction: Reduced from [b]8 → 1.5[/b].  
[*] Added a message when a puzzle unlocks a keybox.  
[*] Map generation updated to guarantee a final puzzle.  
[*] Monster AI adjusted to ignore flashlight toggle noise from survivors.  
[/list]
[b]Maps [/b] 
[list]
[*] Renamed some exit doors.  
[*] Missing Warehouse: Laser Connection moved to the middle of the clocks.  
[*] Rose Crimson: Added a secret door.
[/list]
[b]User Interface & Settings  [/b]
[list]
[*] Added Puzzle Selection Screen – Players can exclude puzzles from randomization.  
[*] Added Random Map Selection Window – Customize which maps are included in the Random Map option.  
[*] Added Photosensitive Correction in [i]Gameplay Settings [/i]– This option will force flashing lights to stay On or Off.  
[*] Difficulty Selection UI Revamp: Now prompts when entering a lobby or clicking Difficulty to help new players customize settings.  
[*] Added Only Friends filter to Lobby Search.  
[*] Random Map Selection now appears at the top of the map list.  
[*] Added a Copy Seed button (Ctrl+V to paste).  
[*] Map Selection UI Overhaul: Displays more maps at once.  
[*] Renamed Game Options to "Difficulty" for clarity.  
[*] Added Gameplay tab in Settings (moved some video options here).  
[/list]
[b]Audio Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Balanced Lurker's music and breathing sounds when hunting.  
[/list][b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a Warehouse light that wasn’t interactable.  
[*] Fixed mouse cursor disappearing when pressing ESC while holding TAB.  
[*] Fixed TAB working while the ESC menu is open.  
[*] Fixed puzzles making noise at the start of the game.  
[*] Fixed ghost items appearing on top of puzzles.  
[*] Fixed small box lids getting stuck.  
[*] Fixed a 4th-floor room missing the Laser Connection End.  
[*] Fixed new puzzles not drawing at the correct distance.  
[*] Fixed Valve not highlighting when inserted into the Pressure Puzzle.  
[*] Fixed host starting with invalid items.  
[*] Fixed hearts graying out when changing localization.  
[*] Fixed multiple issues when playing with the same monster twice in a row.  
[*] Fixed some skill icons flashing red.  
[*] Fixed collision on hospital gurneys.  
[*] Fixed monsters getting too close to doors to open them properly.  
[*] Fixed Mary using skills immediately after transforming.  
[*] Adjusted voice chat attenuation distance for large maps.  
[*] Fixed collision issues blocking Possessed Objects' vision.  
[*] Fixed players getting downed inside the escape room.  
[/list]

[b]Known Issues[/b]
Changing the game language resets the difficulty.

With their expertise in character design and our dedication to delivering seamless gameplay, we are confident that this partnership will take Damned 2 to a whole new level.

A few weeks ago we hosted a pool in our Discord channel to decide the concept art that fits best our next upcoming monster, Mary. Yes! Mary is coming back to haunt your dreams!

Together, with these new partners, we are embarking on an incredible journey to bring you an even more immersive gaming experience.

If you want to know more and get a chance to chat with Matt yourself, get into our Discord channel.

This update also includes a localization system, this means we can now translate the game to as many languages as we want to. So if you wish to help us to bring Damned to your language, get into our Discord to learn how you can help!

notes.title: Damned 2 Update - 0.1.1599
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!
Today I bring you a new patch note. This patch focuses on fixing bugs, improving new door/drawer mechanics, VOIP, usability, networking and game balance. This patch took longer than usual due to the complexity of the door and drawer mechanics that now involve physics.

[b]Highlights:[/b]
[list]
[*] Now the monster can listen to survivors for a brief period of time when they fall into traps. You can hear your friend getting scared, or cursing you =]
[*] 
[*] We have added new containers and safes for you to search for items, the safes can contain all kinds of items, including keys, but you will have to find the password hidden on the map.
[*] 
[*] Various balance adjustments to make the monster have more interaction with survivors, more hunts and more scares.
[*] 
[*] We have added several usability options, such as color blind options and brightness adjustment.
[/list]

A few weeks ago I announced to you that we are working on improvements to the game's audio and sound effects, unfortunately we didn't have time to include these audios before the end of the year, so it will be for the next patch, but we have already approved the material sent by our audio partners and we're excited to see your reaction.

This will be the last patch for this year, but I would like to announce that we are closing partnerships that will take Damned 2 to a new level in 2024 if everything goes well. I can't wait to tell you!

We will also be removing the DEMO version of Damned 2, so new players will need to sign up for our Steam Playtest starting early next year.
So if you have friends who want to join the game before the Playtest, ask them to join our discord and send me a PM.
